slides.0.title: The 14 AOGs at a glance
slides.0.subtitle: Walk from east to west, then check the map
slides.1.title: The East: the Mediterranean and the Algerian border
slides.1.highlights.0.title: Berkane
slides.1.highlights.0.content: The vineyards of Triffa, bounded by the Mediterranean to the north, the border to the east, the Beni-Snassen range to the south and the Moulouya to the west
slides.1.highlights.1.title: Angad
slides.1.highlights.1.content: South of the Beni-Snassen range, reaching the border to the east and the Zekkara massif to the south
slides.1.content: Use the mountains: north of the Beni-Snassen is Berkane, south is Angad.
slides.2.title: Meknès/Fès: the national core
slides.2.highlights.0.title: Guerrouane
slides.2.highlights.0.content: The Meknès plateau, south of the Fès–Meknès–Rabat road, west of the Meknès–El Hajeb road and east of the Beht
slides.2.highlights.1.title: Beni-M'Tir
slides.2.highlights.1.content: The Meknès plateau east of the Meknès–El Hajeb road, home to the AOC Coteaux de l'Atlas
slides.2.highlights.2.title: Zerhoun
slides.2.highlights.2.content: The slopes of the Zerhoun massif, north of the Fès–Meknès–Rabat road
slides.2.highlights.3.title: Saïs and Beni-Sadden
slides.2.highlights.3.content: Saïs is framed by the slopes of Sefrou and Immouzer; Beni-Sadden by the Sebou and Inaouen valleys, running to Fès
slides.2.content: The Meknès–El Hajeb road divides Guerrouane in the west from Beni-M'Tir in the east.
slides.3.title: The Atlantic plains: Rharb to Doukkala
slides.3.highlights.0.title: Rharb
slides.3.highlights.0.content: The rules say only "the vineyards of the Rharb"; the modern spelling is usually Gharb
slides.3.highlights.1.title: Chellah and Zemmour
slides.3.highlights.1.content: Chellah covers both banks of the Bou-Regreg, including the slopes of Rabat and Salé; Zemmour lies between the Beht and Bou-Regreg valleys
slides.3.highlights.2.title: Zaër and Zenata
slides.3.highlights.2.content: Zaër includes the Rommani area and the AOC Les Côtes de Rommani; Zenata's description names places including Ben-Slimane and Oulad-Taleb
slides.3.highlights.3.title: Sahel and Doukkala
slides.3.highlights.3.content: The Oum-er-Rebia is the divide: Sahel on the right bank toward Casablanca, Doukkala on the left bank to the Atlantic, for rosé only
slides.3.content: Use rivers here: the Bou-Regreg, Beht and Oum-er-Rebia are the main dividers.
slides.4.componentProps.slide.title: 🧠 Knowledge check
Guerrouane is west of the road, Beni-M'Tir east.
Which AOG contains Les Côtes de Rommani?
Which AOG lies on the left bank of the Oum-er-Rebia, reaching the Atlantic?
Sahel is on the right bank.
Which AOG lies south of the Beni-Snassen range?
North of the range is Berkane.
